title: Q-RES-ashby-journal-J7: A concept in the register that the code does not carry (measured 0.902, target >= 1.0)
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** research pass: ashby-journal finding J7 is not-met (measured 0.902)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation research --probe ashby-journal:J7
**Prediction:** ashby_concepts_bound_share >= 1 within 72 h
**Out of scope:** editing the study, its target or the paper to match the code; the measurement is changed only by changing the mechanism
**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation research --probe ashby-journal:J7`
**Status:** open

Concern: A concept in the register that the code does not carry. The study: A concept named in the register is a claim that the code implements it. We read every mechanism the register names and count the concepts whose mechanisms all resolve in the repository.

Mechanisms that should answer it: ASHBY-KERNEL-1 (doctrine/ashby-concepts.json); ASHBY-KERNEL-1 (foundation/ashbymap.py).

Metric: share of concepts in doctrine/ashby-concepts.json whose every named mechanism resolves to a file and marker in this repository, target >= 1.0. Improve the mechanism (or add one) until the probe passes; the white paper at /research updates itself from the same measurement.
